product_overview: Goldenmole Construction Management App is a mobile-first operational system for construction and land development teams to centralize daily work logs, financial records, workforce tracking, payroll, and project status. It provides admin-secured access with dashboard visibility and fast field data entry for Android users.
core_goals: Centralize daily construction operations, finance records, workforce tracking, and project management in one system
Enable fast, mobile-friendly daily data entry for field and admin workflows
Provide dashboard visibility for operational and financial status
Support employee management, labor records, and payroll processing with lock controls
Track land projects, planning tasks, and maintenance/vehicle-related operational logs
Enforce role-based access control and admin auditability

features.name: Authentication and Session Management
features.description: Allows admins to sign in securely, optionally keep their session on the device, and access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username/password from LoginScreen -> Receive 200 with JWT/session token -> Store session locally when remember session is enabled -> Navigate to GET /api/dashboard with token -> Receive 200 with dashboard data
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Show login error and remain on LoginScreen
POST /api/auth/logout with active session token -> Receive 200 logout confirmation -> Clear local session and return user to LoginScreen

features.name: Dashboard and Daily Modules
features.description: Shows operational and financial summaries and provides quick navigation to daily data entry modules.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with summary cards and latest operational metrics -> Tap daily module card to open QuickInputScreen -> POST /api/quick-input with daily operation details -> Receive 201 created record
GET /api/dashboard with expired or missing token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Redirect user to LoginScreen or request re-authentication
GET /api/dashboard with valid token but backend unavailable -> Receive 5xx server error -> Show error state and allow retry

features.name: Quick Daily Data Entry
features.description: Supports fast creation of structured field records such as machine work, sand production, events, and other operational inputs from the mobile workflow.
user_flows: POST /api/quick-input with valid daily operation payload from QuickInputScreen -> Receive 201 created record -> Refresh GET /api/dashboard to reflect new totals -> Receive updated summary
POST /api/quick-input with missing required fields or invalid values -> Receive 400 validation error -> Highlight invalid input and prevent submission
POST /api/quick-input with valid payload but no auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Prompt user to log in again

features.name: Transactions Management
features.description: Lets admins create, update, view, and delete income, expense, and leave-related transaction records for financial tracking.
user_flows: POST /api/transactions with Income transaction details, category, amount, and description -> Receive 201 created transaction -> GET /api/transactions to confirm the new record appears -> Receive 200 list with transaction included
PUT /api/transactions/{id} with updated amount or category -> Receive 200 updated transaction -> GET /api/transactions/{id} to verify changes -> Receive 200 updated record
POST /api/transactions with invalid amount or missing required type -> Receive 400 validation error -> Show form error and keep user on TransactionsScreen
DELETE /api/transactions/{id} with no permission or locked record -> Receive 403 forbidden or 409 conflict -> Show deletion failure and preserve record

features.name: Employee and Labor Management
features.description: Maintains employee profiles, wage types, status, and labor-related assignment information for payroll and operations.
user_flows: POST /api/employees with employee profile, wage type, and status -> Receive 201 created employee -> GET /api/employees to confirm the new employee appears -> Receive 200 employee list
PUT /api/employees/{id} with updated role, salary history, or status -> Receive 200 updated employee -> GET /api/employees/{id} -> Receive 200 with updated profile
POST /api/employees with missing required name or invalid wage type -> Receive 400 validation error -> Show field-level errors on EmployeesScreen
GET /api/employees/{id} with unauthorized request -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Require admin login before continuing

features.name: Payroll Generation and Period Lock
features.description: Generates payroll snapshots for a period, stores pay components, and prevents edits when the payroll period is locked.
user_flows: POST /api/payroll/generate with selected period and employee set -> Receive 201 payroll snapshot created -> GET /api/payroll/{period} -> Receive 200 with base pay, deductions, and net pay
POST /api/payroll/{period}/lock with admin token -> Receive 200 period locked -> PUT /api/payroll/{period} rejected after lock -> Receive 409 conflict because edits are blocked
POST /api/payroll/{period}/unlock without sufficient admin rights -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Show access denied and keep payroll locked
POST /api/payroll/generate with incomplete attendance or invalid period -> Receive 400 validation error -> Prompt user to correct source data before regenerating

features.name: Daily Logs for Machine Work, Sand Production, and Events
features.description: Captures operational logs for machine activity, sand production totals, and general events with time and note details.
user_flows: POST /api/logs/machine with machine, hours, work type, and trip data -> Receive 201 created machine log -> GET /api/logs/machine -> Receive 200 with saved log entry
POST /api/logs/sand with morning and afternoon quantities -> Receive 201 created sand production log -> GET /api/logs/sand -> Receive 200 with totals reflected
POST /api/logs/event with category, priority, time, and notes -> Receive 201 created event log -> GET /api/logs/event -> Receive 200 with event entry
POST /api/logs/machine with missing hours or invalid machine reference -> Receive 400 validation error -> Show required-field error and prevent save

features.name: Vehicle and Maintenance Expenses
features.description: Records vehicle-related costs and maintenance entries with date and context for auditability and operational review.
user_flows: POST /api/vehicles/expenses with vehicle cost details and date -> Receive 201 created expense -> GET /api/vehicles/expenses -> Receive 200 with new record visible
POST /api/maintenance with maintenance type, date, and description -> Receive 201 created maintenance entry -> GET /api/maintenance -> Receive 200 with saved maintenance record
POST /api/maintenance with invalid date or missing maintenance type -> Receive 400 validation error -> Show validation message and block submission
PUT /api/vehicles/expenses/{id} with corrected amount or description -> Receive 200 updated expense -> GET /api/vehicles/expenses/{id} -> Receive 200 with corrected values

features.name: Land Project Tracking
features.description: Manages land purchase projects including seller, deed, area, payment values, notes, and lifecycle status from deposit to transfer.
user_flows: POST /api/land-projects with seller, deed, area, payment, and notes -> Receive 201 created project -> GET /api/land-projects -> Receive 200 with project in Deposit status
PUT /api/land-projects/{id} with status PaidFull -> Receive 200 updated project -> GET /api/land-projects/{id} -> Receive 200 with PaidFull status
PUT /api/land-projects/{id} with status Transferred and transfer notes -> Receive 200 updated project -> GET /api/land-projects/{id} -> Receive 200 with Transferred status
POST /api/land-projects with missing seller or invalid area -> Receive 400 validation error -> Show project form errors and prevent save

features.name: Planning and Task Management
features.description: Creates and tracks daily, weekly, and monthly plans with status and carry-over history for unfinished work.
user_flows: POST /api/plans with scope Daily, lane/work type, and task details -> Receive 201 created plan -> GET /api/plans -> Receive 200 showing Todo plan
PUT /api/plans/{id} with status Done -> Receive 200 updated plan -> GET /api/plans/{id} -> Receive 200 showing Done status
POST /api/plans with invalid scope or missing task description -> Receive 400 validation error -> Display validation feedback on CalendarScreen
GET /api/plans?scope=Monthly with valid token -> Receive 200 list of monthly plans and carry-over items -> Review incomplete work history

features.name: Settings, Master Data, and Administration
features.description: Allows super admins to manage app defaults, master data lists, organization profile settings, and admin access control.
user_flows: GET /api/settings with super admin token -> Receive 200 organization profile, branding, and defaults -> Edit settings and POST /api/settings -> Receive 200 saved configuration
POST /api/master-data/categories with new category value -> Receive 201 created master data item -> GET /api/master-data/categories -> Receive 200 with updated list
POST /api/admins with new admin account details from Super Admin flow -> Receive 201 created admin user -> GET /api/admins -> Receive 200 with new account listed
POST /api/admins with insufficient permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Show access denied and prevent user management changes
PUT /api/settings with invalid fuel default or malformed branding data -> Receive 400 validation error -> Keep previous settings unchanged
